title: Weekly Cockpit
description: Morning entry point: this week's training volume by discipline, last night's sleep, flag state, and HRV vs baseline. Read top row first.

list.name: athlete_id
list.query: SELECT a.athlete_id AS __value, a.display_name AS __text FROM core.athlete a ORDER BY a.athlete_id
list.definition: SELECT a.athlete_id AS __value, a.display_name AS __text FROM core.athlete a ORDER BY a.athlete_id

list.name: Notes
list.rawSql: SELECT n.local_date::timestamp AS time, n.note AS text, n.kind AS tags FROM core.note n WHERE n.athlete_id = $athlete_id

target.rawSql: SELECT n.local_date::timestamp AS time, n.note AS text, n.kind AS tags FROM core.note n WHERE n.athlete_id = $athlete_id

panels.title: Flag state
panels.description: Worst flag level on the last night for which HRV was actually measured, not on today. mart.coach_flags only stores rules that FIRED, so a day with no row is a green day -- but a day whose inputs are missing has no row either. Anchoring on the last measured night keeps those two cases apart: Green means the rules ran and stayed quiet, Unknown means nothing could be evaluated at all. Watch the data-age panel next to it: a green light on a five-day-old night is not a green light today.

targets.rawSql: WITH d AS (SELECT max(wb.local_date) AS ld FROM mart.wellness_baseline wb WHERE wb.athlete_id = $athlete_id AND wb.hrv_value IS NOT NULL) SELECT CASE WHEN d.ld IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE coalesce((SELECT max(CASE WHEN cf.level = 'red' THEN 2 WHEN cf.level = 'amber' THEN 1 END) FROM mart.coach_flags cf WHERE cf.athlete_id = $athlete_id AND cf.local_date = d.ld), 0) END AS "Flag state" FROM d

panels.title: Training this week
panels.description: Total timer time of every non-parent session since Monday 00:00, all disciplines together. Timer time, not elapsed: stops at traffic lights are not training. The per-discipline split sits directly below.

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(sum(a.duration_s), 0) / 3600.0 AS "Training this week" FROM core.activity a WHERE a.athlete_id = $athlete_id AND a.is_parent = false AND a.local_date >= date_trunc('week', now())::date

panels.title: Last night's sleep
panels.description: Total sleep duration of LAST NIGHT (wake_date = today, Europe/Paris), independent of the time picker. Red below 6 h, amber below 7 h. EMPTY means there is no row for this morning yet: either the watch reported nothing, or the morning cycle has not ingested it (poll 10:00 -> visible ~10:30). The stage split and the sleep score on the row below apply the same rule.

targets.rawSql: SELECT s.duration_s / 3600.0 AS "Last night's sleep" FROM core.sleep_session s WHERE s.athlete_id = $athlete_id AND s.wake_date = (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Paris')::date

panels.title: HRV vs baseline
panels.description: Deviation of the last measured night's HRV from the rolling baseline, in percent. -15 % is the threshold the hrv_crash rule fires on, which is why it is also the red boundary here. The full series is charted below.

targets.rawSql: SELECT wb.hrv_dev_ratio * 100 AS "HRV vs baseline" FROM mart.wellness_baseline wb WHERE wb.athlete_id = $athlete_id AND wb.hrv_value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY wb.local_date DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Data age (days)
panels.description: Days between today and the last night with a measured HRV value. This is the honesty gauge for every wellness panel above: the flag state, the sleep figure and the HRV deviation all describe that night, not today. Amber from two days, red from four -- at that point the poller has not run, or Garmin has not synced.

targets.rawSql: SELECT (current_date - max(wb.local_date))::int AS "Data age" FROM mart.wellness_baseline wb WHERE wb.athlete_id = $athlete_id AND wb.hrv_value IS NOT NULL

panels.title: This week's training time by discipline
panels.description: core.activity joined to core.sport, is_parent = false, sum(duration_s)/3600 per discipline for the CURRENT ISO week (Monday-based, local_date >= date_trunc('week', now())). Not time-range-filtered -- always shows the current week regardless of the dashboard time picker.

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(sum(a.duration_s) FILTER (WHERE s.discipline = 'run'), 0) / 3600.0 AS "Run", coalesce(sum(a.duration_s) FILTER (WHERE s.discipline = 'bike'), 0) / 3600.0 AS "Bike", coalesce(sum(a.duration_s) FILTER (WHERE s.discipline = 'swim'), 0) / 3600.0 AS "Swim" FROM core.activity a JOIN core.sport s ON s.sport_code = a.sport_code WHERE a.athlete_id = $athlete_id AND a.is_parent = false AND a.local_date >= date_trunc('week', now())::date

panels.title: This week's distance by discipline
panels.description: core.activity joined to core.sport, is_parent = false, sum(distance_m)/1000 per discipline for the CURRENT ISO week. Not time-range-filtered -- always the current week. Swim distance is small in km so this panel uses 2 decimals; run and bike read fine at the same precision.

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(sum(a.distance_m) FILTER (WHERE s.discipline = 'run'), 0) / 1000.0 AS "Run", coalesce(sum(a.distance_m) FILTER (WHERE s.discipline = 'bike'), 0) / 1000.0 AS "Bike", coalesce(sum(a.distance_m) FILTER (WHERE s.discipline = 'swim'), 0) / 1000.0 AS "Swim" FROM core.activity a JOIN core.sport s ON s.sport_code = a.sport_code WHERE a.athlete_id = $athlete_id AND a.is_parent = false AND a.local_date >= date_trunc('week', now())::date

panels.title: Last night's sleep -- stage split
panels.description: Same rule as the panel to its left: LAST NIGHT only (wake_date = today), so the donut is empty exactly when the duration stat is. Broken into deep/light/rem/awake seconds so the split is visual.

targets.rawSql: WITH last_night AS (SELECT s.deep_s, s.light_s, s.rem_s, s.awake_s FROM core.sleep_session s WHERE s.athlete_id = $athlete_id AND s.wake_date = (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Paris')::date) SELECT 'Deep' AS "Stage", deep_s AS "Seconds" FROM last_night UNION ALL SELECT 'Light', light_s FROM last_night UNION ALL SELECT 'REM', rem_s FROM last_night UNION ALL SELECT 'Awake', awake_s FROM last_night

panels.title: Sleep score
panels.description: Garmin's sleep score for LAST NIGHT (wake_date = today, same rule as the duration stat). Red below 60, amber below 75. Empty when the watch reported nothing.

targets.rawSql: SELECT s.sleep_score AS "Sleep score" FROM core.sleep_session s WHERE s.athlete_id = $athlete_id AND s.wake_date = (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Paris')::date

panels.title: HRV vs baseline
panels.description: mart.wellness_baseline: hrv_value (last-night HRV) and hrv_baseline (rolling baseline) plotted together, time-range filtered on local_date. Reading the two lines together shows whether last night is drifting away from the athlete's usual level.

targets.rawSql: SELECT wb.local_date::timestamp AS time, wb.hrv_value AS "HRV", wb.hrv_baseline AS "Baseline" FROM mart.wellness_baseline wb WHERE wb.athlete_id = $athlete_id AND $__timeFilter(wb.local_date) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: HRV deviation from baseline
panels.description: mart.wellness_baseline.hrv_dev_ratio * 100, i.e. (value / baseline - 1) in percent, time-range filtered. This is the actionable number: negative means last night's HRV was below the athlete's rolling baseline, positive means above. Zero line marks 'right on baseline'.

targets.rawSql: SELECT wb.local_date::timestamp AS time, wb.hrv_dev_ratio * 100 AS "HRV deviation" FROM mart.wellness_baseline wb WHERE wb.athlete_id = $athlete_id AND $__timeFilter(wb.local_date) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Fired flags
panels.description: The rules that actually fired on the last night with a measured HRV value -- the same day the flag state above describes. An empty table means every rule stayed quiet on that night, which is the green case; it never means the rules were skipped.

targets.rawSql: WITH d AS (SELECT max(wb.local_date) AS ld FROM mart.wellness_baseline wb WHERE wb.athlete_id = $athlete_id AND wb.hrv_value IS NOT NULL) SELECT to_char(cf.local_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "Date", cf.rule_code AS "Rule", cf.level AS "Level", cf.detail AS "Detail" FROM mart.coach_flags cf JOIN d ON cf.local_date = d.ld WHERE cf.athlete_id = $athlete_id ORDER BY cf.level DESC

panels.title: Daily steps -- last weeks
panels.description: core.daily_wellness.steps per day, time-range filtered. Empty until the daily step endpoint is added to the poller -- steps currently has zero non-null rows in this dataset, so this panel will show No data until that collection gap is closed.

targets.rawSql: SELECT w.local_date::timestamp AS time, w.steps AS "Steps" FROM core.daily_wellness w WHERE w.athlete_id = $athlete_id AND $__timeFilter(w.local_date) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Recent sessions
panels.description: The 15 most recent sessions, independent of the time picker so the panel is never empty. Multisport events appear as a single Triathlon row, not as one row per leg. Clicking a row opens a menu: the matching Session detail dashboard (Run, Bike, Swim or Triathlon) for that activity. Single SQL-computed detail_url per row: one oneClick link, no link menu.

targets.rawSql: SELECT comb."Date" AS "Date", comb."Sport" AS "Sport", comb."Name" AS "Name", comb."Duration" AS "Duration", comb."Distance" AS "Distance", comb."Avg HR" AS "Avg HR", comb."TSS" AS "TSS", comb."activity_id" AS "activity_id", comb."start_ms" AS "start_ms", comb."end_ms" AS "end_ms", comb."duration_ms" AS "duration_ms", comb."detail_url" AS "detail_url" FROM (SELECT to_char(aw.local_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "Date", s.label AS "Sport", aw.name AS "Name", aw.duration_s / 3600.0 AS "Duration", aw.distance_m / 1000.0 AS "Distance", aw.avg_hr AS "Avg HR", aw.tss AS "TSS", aw.activity_id::text AS "activity_id", (extract(epoch from a.start_time) * 1000)::bigint AS "start_ms", (extract(epoch from a.start_time + make_interval(secs => coalesce(a.elapsed_s, a.duration_s))) * 1000)::bigint AS "end_ms", coalesce(a.elapsed_s, a.duration_s)::bigint * 1000 AS "duration_ms", CASE s.discipline WHEN 'run' THEN '/d/t0-session-run/session-detail-run?var-activity_id=' || aw.activity_id::text || '&from=0&to=' || (coalesce(a.elapsed_s, a.duration_s)::bigint * 1000)::text WHEN 'bike' THEN '/d/t0-session-bike/session-detail-bike?var-activity_id=' || aw.activity_id::text || '&from=' || ((extract(epoch from a.start_time) * 1000)::bigint)::text || '&to=' || ((extract(epoch from a.start_time + make_interval(secs => coalesce(a.elapsed_s, a.duration_s))) * 1000)::bigint)::text WHEN 'swim' THEN '/d/t0-session-swim/session-detail-swim?var-activity_id=' || aw.activity_id::text || '&from=' || ((extract(epoch from a.start_time) * 1000)::bigint)::text || '&to=' || ((extract(epoch from a.start_time + make_interval(secs => coalesce(a.elapsed_s, a.duration_s))) * 1000)::bigint)::text END AS "detail_url" FROM mart.activity_wide aw JOIN core.activity a ON a.activity_id = aw.activity_id JOIN core.sport s ON s.sport_code = aw.sport_code WHERE a.athlete_id = $athlete_id AND a.is_parent = false AND a.parent_activity_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT to_char(ts.local_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'Triathlon', ts.name, ts.duration_s / 3600.0, ts.distance_m / 1000.0, ts.avg_hr, ts.tss, ts.activity_id::text, (extract(epoch from a.start_time) * 1000)::bigint, (extract(epoch from a.start_time + make_interval(secs => ts.duration_s)) * 1000)::bigint, ts.duration_s::bigint * 1000, 't0-session-tri/session-detail-tri?var-activity_id=' || ts.activity_id::text || '&from=' || ((extract(epoch from a.start_time) * 1000)::bigint)::text || '&to=' || ((extract(epoch from a.start_time + make_interval(secs => ts.duration_s)) * 1000)::bigint)::text FROM mart.triathlon_session ts JOIN core.activity a ON a.activity_id = ts.activity_id WHERE a.athlete_id = $athlete_id) comb ORDER BY comb."Date" DESC LIMIT 15
